metadata.name: agama_solana
metadata.description: Agama on Solana: deposit a tokenized stock, get more of it back

instructions.name: amplify_close
docs: Sell just enough stock to repay, hand the rest back.

instructions.name: amplify_open
docs: Deposit stock, loop it to `leverage_bps` (10_000 = 1x) in one go: the
borrow buys more of the same stock, pledged with the rest.

instructions.name: compound
docs: Turn the vault yield above the debt into more of the stock. The swap is
priced off the same oracle the market uses, so the caller has nothing
to choose and nothing to skim.

instructions.name: earn_close
docs: Repay out of the vault shares first, then the wallet for any shortfall,
hand the stock back and the leftover yield as USDC.

instructions.name: earn_deposit
docs: Deposit stock (open or top up) and set the level. Borrows up to it at
once; from then on the agents keep it there.

instructions.name: earn_set_target
docs: Move the slider. The position goes there now, both ways.

instructions.name: liquidate
docs: Backstop. The yield buffer goes first; only if that is not enough does
the liquidator repay and take stock at the bonus.

instructions.name: on_report
docs: The Chainlink CRE receiver. The forwarder calls this after verifying
the DON's signatures (the mock forwarder after nothing: then the
transmitter is checked instead). The markets to price follow `cre` and
the instructions sysvar in the accounts. Same bounds as the keeper.

accounts.name: instructions
docs: to check who transmitted the report.

instructions.name: poke
docs: Accrue interest and vault yield. Anyone, any time.

instructions.name: push_price
docs: The keeper relays Pyth: the equity feed while the session trades, the
xStock token's own 24/7 feed outside it. Bounded per push, and the
publish time only moves forward.

instructions.name: rebalance
docs: Hold the level the owner picked, both ways, with a 1% band.

instructions.name: set_cre
docs: Point the receiver at a forwarder deployment and, optionally, pin the
workflow owner.

types.name: CreConfig
docs: Where Chainlink CRE reports may come from. The Keystone Forwarder verifies
the DON's signatures, then CPIs `on_report` signed by a PDA of
`["forwarder", forwarder_state, this program]`; the receiver checks that PDA
and the workflow owner in the metadata.

fields.name: workflow_owner
docs: EVM-style address of the workflow owner, as CRE puts it in the
metadata. Required outside simulation: the Keystone Forwarder proves
the DON signed a report, not which customer's workflow produced it.

fields.name: workflow_name
docs: The workflow name as CRE puts it in the metadata (10 bytes). Pinned
with the owner outside simulation.

fields.name: simulation
docs: True while the forwarder is the CLI's mock, which relays anything
without checking signatures. Reports are then accepted only when the
transaction's transmitter (the key running the simulator) is this one.

fields.name: last_price_at
docs: Last time a report actually moved a price: the liveness the app shows.

fields.name: offhours_buffer_bps
docs: Taken off both LTV and threshold while the share does not trade.

fields.name: price_time
docs: Publish time of the source the price came from.

fields.name: collateral
docs: Stock pledged, in the stock's base units (8 decimals).

fields.name: shares
docs: Earn only: vault shares bought with the borrowed USDC. A free buffer,
not pledged: it repays the debt before the stock is ever sold.

fields.name: target_ltv_bps
docs: The level the owner picked. The agents hold the position there.

fields.name: leverage_bps
docs: Amplify only: the loop multiple, 10_000 = 1x.

types.name: PriceReport
docs: The Borsh payload a CRE workflow writes: a few markets per report, since a
Solana transaction leaves the forwarder ~265 bytes once accounts are paid.

types.name: PriceUpdate
docs: One price in a CRE report.

types.name: Protocol
docs: The lending pool, the private credit vault and every mint the program
controls hang off this one PDA. It signs for all of them.

fields.name: keeper
docs: Pushes prices. Bounded on chain, so a bad keeper can drift a price by
at most `max_jump_bps` per push, never set it.

fields.name: cash
docs: USDC the pool holds and can lend.

fields.name: borrow_index
docs: Grows with the borrow rate. Debt = scaled * index / WAD.

fields.name: nav_wad
docs: USDC per share, WAD. Accrues at `vault_apr_bps`.

fields.name: vault_cash
docs: USDC actually sitting in the vault account.

fields.name: coupons_paid
docs: Coupons the credit book paid into the vault (devnet stand-in: minted).
